Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human GnRH receptor (CHEMBL1855). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key and docs for provenance. Join compound_structures as INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1855 and standard_type IC50. Require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
